WITH res_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        ba.beneopsref as opsregistry,
        (0.4 * AVG(CAST(t.delivery_metrics->'delivery_performance'->>'success_rate' AS numeric))) + 
        (0.3 * AVG(ba.bene_feedbackscore) * 10) + 
        (0.3 * AVG(ba.distequityidx) * 100) as res_score
    FROM beneficiariesandassessments ba
    JOIN disasterevents de ON ba.bene_dist_ref = de.distregistry
    LEFT JOIN transportation t ON de.distregistry = t.transportdistref
    GROUP BY ba.beneopsref
),
cqi_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        ce.coordopsref as opsregistry,
        (ce.report_compliance + (ce.stakeholder_satisf * 20) + (ce.dataqualityvalue * 20)) / 3.0 as cqi_score
    FROM coordinationandevaluation ce
    GROUP BY ce.coordopsref, ce.report_compliance, ce.stakeholder_satisf, ce.dataqualityvalue
),
op_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        r.opsregistry,
        ROUND(CAST(r.res_score AS numeric), 2) as res,
        ROUND(CAST(c.cqi_score AS numeric), 2) as cqi
    FROM res_calc r
    INNER JOIN cqi_calc c ON r.opsregistry = c.opsregistry
    WHERE r.res_score > 75 AND c.cqi_score > 75
)
SELECT 
    os.opsregistry,
    os.res,
    os.cqi,
    o.emerglevel,
    o.resp_phase,
    o.opsstatus,
    o.coordcenter,
    o.ops_start_date,
    o.estdurationdays
FROM op_scores os
JOIN operations o ON os.opsregistry = o.opsregistry
ORDER BY os.res DESC, os.cqi DESC;
